projects.name: Vesserith
projects.summary: A commit-bound GitHub Pages view of reviewed evidence for Vesserith, Mynyra, and Hova.

evidence.label: Deployment observed
evidence.detail: GitHub Actions published the read-only dashboard from commit 528d3aa288c72737478636b9d72923d520a98541; the default Pages URL, project routes, and exact build provenance were observed.

boundaries: Owns this public registry, evidence method, navigation, and publication workflow.
Does not own product runtime state, private records, or credentials.
Remains useful when Mynyra or Hova is unavailable.
projects.nextGate: Maintain the Pages dashboard and refresh reviewed evidence only through explicit repository changes.

projects.name: Mynyra
projects.summary: An offline-first trading control room and engine with a static public presentation boundary.

evidence.label: Repository observed
evidence.detail: The public UI is static and disconnected from the imported engine; current proof is provider-free and non-trading.

boundaries: Current public experience is static presentation, not an engine cockpit.
Offline proof requires provider and order permissions to remain false.
The Pages dashboard cannot become a trading or credential boundary.
projects.nextGate: Generate sanitized, commit-bound offline evidence without introducing a product backend.

projects.name: Hova
projects.summary: The Tracker project, pending source and data-lineage reconciliation before any implementation is adopted.

evidence.label: Reconciliation pending
evidence.detail: Adjacent hosted, SQLite, Manus, and Android lineages are preserved evidence; none is canonical yet.

boundaries: The declared Hova repository is a shell; adjacent implementations are preserved evidence.
No source or persistent store becomes canonical before read-only reconciliation.
The first canonical application remains single-user and independently authenticated.
projects.nextGate: Inventory adjacent source and persistent-store authority without exposing record content.
